description: Simulate a match between players from two teams. Provide player IDs for both teams (use the "search-players" tool to get them). Returns: name (of the match), probability (win probability of team_1 and team_2 as a percentage), favorite ("team_1" or "team_2", null if evenly rated), elo_diff (Padel API Elo gap between the teams), played_at (day the simulation is rated for) and players (the full player details per team).

played_at.description: Day the match would be played, as YYYY-MM-DD. Players are rated with the Elo they had entering that day, so you can replay a past match-up with the ratings of the time. Optional, defaults to today.

team_1.description: List of player IDs for team 1

team_2.description: List of player IDs for team 2

name: simulate-match
